name: Deployment of Prantiya Rakshak Dal (PRD) Volunteers (For volunteer)
benefit: Under this scheme, PRD volunteers are paid a daily honorarium of ₹570/- for providing police assistance and performing duties in various offices.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a youth (male or female) aged between 18 and 42 years. 1. The applicant must be a Prantiya Rakshak Dal (PRD) volunteer.
